tfng.title: Reading · True / False / Not Given
passage: Urban beekeeping has grown rapidly in many European cities over the past two decades. In London alone, the number of registered hives more than doubled within roughly five years. Supporters argue that rooftop hives help to reverse the decline in bee populations, yet some ecologists are less convinced.

They point out that honeybees compete with wild bees for the same limited supply of flowers, and that adding hives without planting more flowers may actually harm native species. Several city councils have therefore begun to encourage residents to plant pollinator-friendly gardens rather than simply install new hives.
Honey produced in cities often contains fewer pesticide residues than honey from farmland, although researchers caution that this may vary considerably from one city to another.
qs: The number of registered hives in London increased by over 100% in about five years.
"more than doubled within roughly five years" = tăng hơn 100%.
All ecologists believe urban beekeeping benefits wild bees.
Bài nói "some ecologists are less convinced" → trái với "all … believe".
Honeybees and wild bees feed on different flowers.
"compete … for the same limited supply of flowers" → trái ngược.
Some city councils give residents free seeds.
Bài chỉ nói "encourage residents to plant" — không nhắc tới hạt giống miễn phí.
City honey is always free from pesticide residues.
"fewer pesticide residues" ≠ "free from"; thêm nữa "may vary".
Urban beekeeping is more popular in Europe than in Asia.
Bài không so sánh với châu Á.

headings.title: Reading · Matching headings
heads: ii. An idea originally driven by economic necessity
iii. Output maintained in less time
iv. Not a solution for every industry
v. Governments plan to make the policy law
paras: When companies first experimented with shorter working weeks, the aim was rarely to improve wellbeing. In the 1930s, some manufacturers cut hours mainly to spread a limited amount of work among more employees during the economic depression.
Ý chính: cắt giờ vì kinh tế khó khăn ("economic depression") → economic necessity.

Recent trials have reported that staff who work four days often complete the same amount of work as before. Managers attribute this to fewer unnecessary meetings and a stronger focus during working hours.
"complete the same amount of work" trong 4 ngày = output maintained in less time.
However, the model does not suit every sector. Hospitals, schools and shops must remain open on fixed days, so reducing hours there frequently requires hiring additional staff, which raises costs.
"does not suit every sector" = not a solution for every industry. (i và v là tiêu đề nhiễu.)

listen.title: Listening · Form completion (Part 1)
listen.note: Bấm ▶ Nghe — app đọc đoạn hội thoại bằng giọng máy. Điền ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. Chú ý bẫy tự sửa!
script: A
Good morning, Riverside Sports Centre. How can I help?
B
Hi, I would like to join the adult swimming course.
A
Of course. Can I take your surname, please?
B
Yes, it is Fletcher. F, L, E, T, C, H, E, R.
A
Thank you. Which evening would suit you? We have Tuesday and Thursday.
B
Tuesday is no good for me, I work late. So Thursday, please.
A
Fine. The course normally costs ninety-five pounds, but there is a discount for new members, so for you it is eighty-five.
B
Great. Do I need to bring anything?
A
Just a towel and some goggles. We provide the swimming cap.
B
And how many weeks does it last?
A
It was ten weeks last year, but now it runs for twelve.
qs: Bẫy: Tuesday được nhắc trước nhưng bị loại.
Bẫy: 95 là giá gốc; sau giảm giá còn 85.
Cap được trung tâm cung cấp → không phải đáp án.
